snippet.title: Tablecraft - Early Access Trailer | Meta Quest VR Gameplay
snippet.description:
Tablecraft is a #VR mad science sandbox. Craft stuff out of the atoms, experiment on your test subjects, fulfil visitor requests and rediscover the entire Periodic Table!

Get Tablecraft on Meta Quest:
https://vr.meta.me/s/1KQyGcK4sRfiBhB

Be sure to join our Discord for exclusive content, friendly banter, and the latest news straight from the devs!
https://www.notsuspicious.biz/discord

Learn more about the game:
https://www.notsuspicious.biz/tablecraft

Recorded on #MetaQuest3. Available on #MetaQuest2, #MetaQuestPro and #MetaQuest3 family.

Other links:
https://x.com/notsuspicioushq
